question: How many Mandalas are there in the Rigveda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ten.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Each Veda is a** compilation of hymns written by several priest families.**
 
• Rig-Veda is also divided into ten volumes known as **Mandalas**.
 
• The** first and tenth Mandalas** are the youngest and longest boo
